text.text: Report a bug, triage it, fix it, ship it. The board shows where every bug is; the dashboard shows what needs attention first.
Open any bug to find a report outline (steps, expected, actual, where) ready to fill in.
Triage happens every weekday at ten. Each bug leaves the Reported column that day.

cells.text: Data loss, security, or nobody can sign in
A main feature is broken for many people
Something is wrong but there is a workaround

text.text: Severity says how bad it is. Priority says when we fix it, which also depends on how many people it touches and how hard it is.
Reproduce it, or ask the reporter for more.
Look for a duplicate; link it and set the status to Duplicate.
Assign an owner and move it to Triaged.
When the cost is far larger than the harm and the product owner agrees. Write the reason in the bug.

Each release collects the bugs it fixes. Open a bug, set its release, and the counts above update. A release moves from Planned to Rolling out the day it reaches the first customers, and to Released when everyone has it.
Critical share shows how much of a release was emergency work. A release that is mostly critical fixes means the last one shipped too fast.
